title: goulHash
tagline: PoC to enable swaps between EVM chains and Cardano in Fusion+
description:
Fusion+ now supports cross-chain swaps for validators.
Currently, this functionality is limited to EVM chains, but theoretically, the underlying design allows for the future inclusion of non-EVM chains.

In a related development, 1Inch is reportedly working on a Solana implementation, though it is not yet publicly available.

This project aims to lay the foundation for swaps specifically between EVM chains and Cardano by providing the necessary key elements.
